summary: V2 backend + frontend testing completed. Created /app/backend/tests/test_v2_features.py with 32 pytest cases covering new V2 functionality (Rak Type B pricing, phone validation, multi-item cart orders, weighted photo match, analytics, finance auto-revenue dedupe, multi-admin permissions, admin email/password change, security 401/404, overview filters). All 32 tests pass. Playwright verified the customer flow (configure Rak Kayu 565 LE base, dynamic pricing to 1515 LE, add-to-cart with cart count increment, cart qty +/- updates subtotal, checkout with intl phone validation, order confirmation with SGF number) and the admin flow (language switch ID/EN/AR with RTL toggle on documentElement, admin login, overview stat cards clickable and navigate to filtered /admin/orders?status=pesanan_masuk, analytics/finance/admins/settings pages render with all expected testids).

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary payload dict; no Pydantic validation for product update body (allowlist enforced only on settings endpoint).
No validation that from_amount>0 and to_amount>0; a zero/negative transfer would be accepted.

Older backend_test.py::TestPricing::test_rak_80_5_A_pernis still hard-codes pre-migration base 2100 for 80_5. After V2 Rak Type B migration real base is 1335 (unit 1515). Legacy pricing test in backend_test.py would fail; kept as-is per scope but should be updated by main agent.

issues: Data-testids exposed: stat-total, stat-pesanan_masuk, stat-diproses, stat-siap, stat-selesai, stat-dibatalkan, stat-lunas, stat-belum_dibayar, stat-revenue. Missing stat-dikonfirmasi and stat-dp cards (spec listed them). Low priority — could be intentional grouping.

action_items: (Optional) Update legacy backend_test.py::TestPricing::test_rak_80_5_A_pernis to new Type B base (1335 -> unit 1515) so the older regression file stays green.
(Optional) Add stat-dikonfirmasi and stat-dp cards on Admin overview to match spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1246 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting routers (auth, orders, finance, admin_products, admins) into modules.
admin_update_product accepts raw Dict[str, Any] without an allowlist; malicious keys could inject fields into the products doc.

record_order_revenue key uses str(order['_id']); dedupe correct. However there's no reverse action if payment_status is changed from lunas -> belum_dibayar (orphan revenue remains). Consider deleting the auto-revenue when unlunas.

compute_item_price: finishing for 'meja' expects scalar (fin_cost when not dict) but the code sets fin_cost=0 when it is a dict — fine for current data but silently zeros invalid config. Add validation.

photo_similarity: exact-match bonus (+100) is applied but requires that all weight keys present in attributes match; if any attribute is missing/empty it's skipped from exact check — potential false exacts when photo has partial attributes.
CORS: allow_origins strictly from env — good. samesite=none + secure=true cookie requires HTTPS in dev too — OK for the preview domain.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created via API during tests (TEST_ prefixed names). Sub-admin test_manager_v2@example.com created then deleted. All V2 seed products already in DB with post-migration Type B base prices.
